title: Jordan Peterson - Women in High Paying Jobs
summary: A clip of psychologist Jordan Peterson discussing why few women reach high-paying, high-pressure jobs. He talks about the tension between a demanding career and having a family.
why: HN cites it in threads on gender gaps in tech and law, though some commenters point to a longer Peterson video for the full argument.

quote.text: Jordan Peterson had one of the best takes on why successful women struggle to make both a family and a career happen
